title: Render Report
description: Output report produced by the Composer agent after rendering.

render_grammar.description: Which renderer family was used for this render

decision_log_ref.description: Path to the project's cumulative decision log

final_review_ref.description: Path or inline reference to the final_review artifact produced by post-render self-review. Provides durable audit linkage between the render output and its quality inspection.

output_path.description: Convenience pointer at the primary output. Redundant with outputs[0].path and kept only so a reader does not have to index into the array.

composition_id.description: Composition actually rendered, e.g. PersianFootageVertical. Recorded because format and composition can disagree, and the disagreement is invisible in the MP4.

format.description: Frame orientation of the render, for cross-checking against the brief.

duration_seconds.description: Measured output duration, from ffprobe rather than from the plan.

attributions.description: Credit line per clip used. Both Pexels and Pixabay require attribution, so a render whose attributions do not cover every clip has shipped a licence violation.

moment_count.description: Typographic moments painted (persian-footage). 7-9 for a 60-second video: the 0.55 coverage ceiling and the reading floor together force fewer, richer, slower moments, and 12-15 cannot fit under the ceiling at honest durations (see MAX_TEXT_COVERAGE in lib/persian_moments.py).

text_coverage.description: Fraction of the runtime carrying on-screen type (persian-footage). The single number distinguishing a typographic edit from a caption track, and invisible in the MP4 without measuring it. Above 0.55 the moment audit fails the edit.

subtitle_path.description: Sidecar .srt written beside the output from the narration's word timings. Absent in silent mode, which has no speech to subtitle.

subtitle_advisories.description: Readability notes on the sidecar subtitles. Advisories rather than failures on purpose: an over-speed cue is a property of how fast the narrator spoke, and the honest remedy is a shorter script, not a blocked delivery.

delivery_status.description: Lifecycle of a rendered candidate; final_candidate awaits the user’s one post-render review.

human_visual_approval.description: False for automation. Only explicit approval of the rendered output may set it true.

persian_text_verified.description: False on an automatically produced Persian final candidate. It may become true only after the user approves that render; verification_notes still records the automated measurements and their limits.

verification_frames.description: Extracted frames the numeric verification was run against, so the measurements can be re-run or disputed.
